svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 42 mm of 20 x 3 mm flat bar; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4.4 mm holes on the centre line, 4 and 12 mm from one end:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: these bolt to the socket-side upright with M4 bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Hall pickup sits on the other end, its centre 26 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolted end; mark its lug holes through the pickup and drill to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bracket lies flat on the inside face of the upright,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level with the axle, and reaches toward the module. The pickup's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face is 3.5 mm from the magnet ring, at the ring's magnet circle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: spin the wheel by hand; the ring passes the pickup without

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: touching and the gap is 3 to 4 mm all round.
